 Here are the Cricket Predictions for the Women's Big Bash League 2026 - 15th Match - Sydney Sixers Women vs Sydney Thunder Women and 16th Match - Perth Scorchers Women vs Melbourne Stars Women, to be played on the 8th of November at the Junction Oval, Melbourne and North Sydney Oval, Sydney.
 Match Prediction - Sydney Sixers Women v Sydney Thunder Women 
 15th Match - Sydney Sixers Women vs Sydney Thunder Women (North Sydney Oval, Sydney) 
 Ground Stat:
 Average 1st Innings Total at North Sydney Oval, Sydney (Women's Big Bash League) - 159 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at North Sydney Oval, Sydney (Women's Big Bash League) - 144 
 Current Form Sydney Sixers Women:
 Sydney Sixers Women are currently placed at the 1st position on points table with 3 wins to their credit. They have 6 points to their name. Their NRR is 1.517. 
 The top run scorer for Sydney Sixers Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Ashleigh Gardner with 160 runs to her name. 
 The top wicket taker for Sydney Sixers Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Ashleigh Gardner with 6 scalps under her belt. 
 Sydney Sixers Women have won their previous match against Melbourne Stars Women by just 1 run. 
 Sydney Sixers Women batted first and they posted a total of 160 for 5 in 20 overs. Sophia Dunkley and Amelia Kerr got out without troubling the scorers much. After their dismissals, Ellyse Perry and Ashleigh Gardner took the responsibility of taking Sydney Sixers Women over the line. Gardner made 34 runs while Perry went on to score 84 runs in only 57 balls, collecting 13 fours and 1 six. Erin Burns also made a nice contribution of 29 runs in the middle order as Sydney Sixers Women managed to reach a competitive total of 160 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Rhys McKenna and Meg Lanning got out cheaply. Amy Jones and Annabel Sutherland then tried to revive the innings with knocks of 28 and 22 runs respectively but they were quite short lived. There was a lot of struggle in middle overs but Danielle Gibson batted superbly. She made 31 runs off only 20 balls, hitting 2 fours and 2 sixes. Her dismissal in the last over was the turning point. Georgia Prestwidge stayed not out at 21 but failed to take Melbourne Stars Women over the line as they eventually fell short by just 1 run.
 Current Form Sydney Thunder Women:
 Sydney Thunder Women are currently placed at the 3rd position on points table with 2 wins and 1 loss to their credit. They have 4 points to their name. Their NRR is 0.739. 
 The top run scorer for Sydney Thunder Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Heather Knight with 110 runs to her name. 
 The top wicket taker for Sydney Thunder Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Georgia Voll with 6 scalps under her belt. 
 Sydney Thunder Women have lost their previous match against Perth Scorchers Women by 17 runs. 
 Perth Scorchers Women batted first and they posted a total of 183 for 3 in 20 overs. Beth Mooney played really well at the top. She scored 80 runs in only 55 balls, hitting 8 fours and 1 six. Sophie Devine and Freya Kemp also contributed quite well and made 42 and 30 runs respectively. On the back of such brilliant performances with the bat, Perth Scorchers Women managed to get past the 180 run mark, finishing at 183 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Sydney Thunder Women lost the key wicket of Georgia Voll quite early. After her dismissal, Phoebe Litchfield and Anika Learoyd played really well, stitching a partnership of 41 runs for the 2nd wicket. There were sporadic contributions by Heather Knight, Tahlia Wilson and Laura Harris but none of them significant enough to take Sydney Thunder Women over the line. They eventually fell short by 17 runs.
